newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil spreads stable in slow talk.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil spreads stable in slow talk.

text.p: European gas oil differentials were stable in lacklustre discussion on Monday, traders said.
August IPE was 25 cents firmer at $167.75 a tonne in rangebound business and meagre volume.
Traders said no bids were heard early in the key ARA barge market, reflecting the continuing high dollar against the mark.
The strong U.S. currency, trading near six-year highs at 1.8460 against the mark at 1112 GMT, has curbed demand from German end-users unwilling to pay dollar-inflated prices.
Notional barge values were around August IPE +$0.50 for Rotterdam refinery material for both prompt and early August.
"There is no real requirement for this. It's high summer, plus many people are on holiday," said one trader.
Barges of EN590 low sulphur diesel were notionally assessed at August IPE +$4 for prompt and +$4.25 for early August.
North west European cargo traders differed over the value of 0.2 percent sulphur heating oil, which moved on Friday at both August IPE +$2 and +$0.75 cif Hamburg for early August.
Some dismissed a view that heating oil storage was tight, and said reduced Russian liftings had been well forecast.
